entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's completely useless and I want my money back. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
The name is Mike Schmidt. Order number is... VF789012. You guys take forever to ship things and then the product doesn't even work right.

Thank you, Mr. Schmidt. I'm pulling up your account now... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Let me just ask to be sure, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or just a preference?
I don't care what you call it. It doesn't track my cadence properly, and I'm done with it. I want to return it. It's that simple.
I understand your frustration. Looking at the delivery date, it shows it was delivered to you 44 days ago. I'm afraid it might be **too late** to process a return for this item.
Too late?! What are you talking about? Your website says 90 days! Are you trying to scam me?

Sir, I understand, but our updated return **policy** on wearable electronics is much stricter. Because these devices are worn on the body, there's a significant **hygiene** and **sanitation** risk, so we have a hard stop on returns after 20 days.

THAT IS UNACCEPTABLE! I bought it based on the policy I saw! This is bait-and-switch! Put me through to your manager right now! I'm going to blast VeloFit on every review site and social media platform I can find!
Please give me just one moment to review the documentation, Mr. Schmidt. I want to be absolutely certain I am applying the correct policy to your specific product. Just one moment.
Fine. But you have ten seconds before I hang up and file a chargeback.

Thank you for holding. Sir, I sincerely apologize. You are absolutely correct. I was looking at the policy for our new Pulse series devices. Your VeloBand Cadence Sensor falls under our standard 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh. So you can process the return, then?

Yes, absolutely. I'm so sorry for that confusion. I have just authorized the return and generated a prepaid shipping label for you. I'm emailing it to the address on file right now. Do you have access to that?
Yeah, I'm looking at it now. It just came through. So I just print this and drop it off?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. That's it. Thank you.
You're very welcome, and again, my apologies for the mix-up. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
